title: T10 — Statement of Architecture Work (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Statement of Architecture Work — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Assignment

Rework the V2 slice T10 (SPEC_V2 §8.2, §8.3 and §12; issues #82 and #502) through the
reconstituted TOGAF/MSP lifecycle: the seven A–D artefacts, the charter, this statement and the
delivery contract, the one WBS deliverable, the Phase-G review and the project's published
outputs. The project was already `closed`; this pass records the lifecycle retrospectively and
the rework's own gate is `acceptance/programme/T10.toml`.

## Scope

The SAFe cadence and MSP tranche machinery: the cadence state machine, WSJF and WIP-bounded
materialisation behind an approved PI plan, backlog refinement, the demo credit, the retro
lesson requirement, the tranche review and its evidence, and the benefit transition with its
baseline measurement. Out of scope: the decision ladder (T2), the plan-spine baseline contract
(T1), the coach card (T4) except the retro card, metrics (T11) and the one-organisation-loop
acceptance (T12).

## Responsibilities

Delivery and the record: the programme architect (`conveyor-e2e`). Approval: `conveyor-approver`,
distinct from the requester. The Architecture Board (`conveyor-architecture-board`) approves the
A–D set and the delivery contract.

## Acceptance criteria

The SPEC_V2 §12 T10 gate, clause by clause, proved at review scope by the named tests in the
Phase-G review; the A–D set and this contract are board-approved; the Phase-G review cites the
standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14` and records the compliance level
`compliant with named deviations`. The manifest is the gate, not this document.

## Contract

The live `statement_of_architecture_work` contract `01a20289-2b08-7ea3-96f6-b2ac928a7be4`,
board-approved by a decision of the Architecture Board, with an approver distinct from the
requester.
